segments.text: It's the eve of Malaysia Day, and you're on the office celebration committee — the whole team is counting on you.
Earn our three awards — Peer Unicorn, Super Achiever, Beyond Boundaries — and light up the party. Ready?
Halfway there! Five minutes on the clock.
Keep those trophies coming — the celebration is waiting.
Three trophies collected. The rooftop lights blaze on — you pulled it off for the whole team.
And here's the secret: tomorrow isn't Merdeka Day. Merdeka was the 31st of August, 1957.
Tomorrow — the 16th of September, 1963 — is the day Malaya, Sabah, Sarawak and Singapore became Malaysia.
Well done, everyone! Happy Malaysia Day!
Time's up! The party fizzles — but only for now.
Take a breath and try again. The trophies are still waiting.

_editable_note: To personalize the ending for your event, edit the last success segment: replace 'everyone' with a winner's name or team (e.g. 'Well done, Team Nebula!'). Then regenerate voice audio with tools/narrative_to_voice.py.
